# Blessings (Focus / Agility)

- **Status:** ⬜ Pending
- **Mechanic tags:** damage-pool, buff
- **Backlog:** `BLESSING-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

Any modelled skill. Acquire Focus Blessing stacks (and separately Agility); set the same stack count in the app under Conditions. Parse at 0 vs max (4).

## Derived / confirmed formula

Focus = **+5% additional damage per stack**, stacks **ADD** → ×1.20 at 4 (NOT 1.05⁴). Agility = +4% Attack & Cast Speed and +2% additional damage per stack. Focus and Agility additional pools **multiply** with each other.
